analogy.rationale: Calcium channel activators act on CACNA1C/CACNA1S/CASR, which are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so transcriptional response should be weak; the closest reference classes are other calcium-channel-directed mechanisms, though blockers oppose rather than mimic activation.
